text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Botswana Defence Force pilot was killed when his plane crashed while on routine flying exercise near the base.

- A rape suspect who has tested HIV positive has been refused bail and is detained in a communal barracks with 80 other inmates. The Prisons Department said it does not know of any plans to counsel HIV positive prisoners or detainees.
